## 4537fc1035d2

**Classification: reproduced generated-instance / validator contract defect.** No patch was made because this is an audit-only target.

Generator SHA-256 `cc0bfc5d70ff57553da59b2c13b8592eba762fb65750b31cd15c88fa74a95ed8` advertises `no_green_objects` in `DEGENERATE_TEXTURES`. At seed `20261005`, sample index `0`, medium difficulty, override `{"texture":"no_green_objects"}`, its own `generate` function returns a 10×10 all-zero grid. That input belongs to the generator’s explicitly documented degenerate domain, but `self_check` returns:

```text
no non-bg cells (expected green T-tetrominoes)
```

The canonical Racket authority executes safely and returns the same blank 10×10 grid, so this is not a rule crash; it is a contradiction between the advertised generator domain and public validator. Exact generation metadata and grid are in `checks/audit/4537fc1035d2/generation.json`; the combined finding is `checks/audit/4537fc1035d2/finding.json`.

Authority was obtained with the supported command (effective working directory `repo`):

```text
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply 4537fc1035d2 \
  --input ../checks/audit/4537fc1035d2/input.json \
  --out ../checks/audit/4537fc1035d2/racket.json
```

It exited 0 and records executed rule hash `ab2e8d1cd6d8`. A repair should remove/declare the texture incompatible or make `self_check` accept the documented blank degenerate; the choice depends on whether empty lessons are intended.
